aboutMe.name: Marcos Wiendl
aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph1: Hello! I'm Marcos, {{age}} years old. I'm a full stack developer focused on creating digital solutions that combine intuitive interfaces with robust back-ends. I enjoy solving problems with creativity and delivering real value to users.
aboutMe.paragraph2: I recently graduated in Web Development and I'm looking for an opportunity to apply all the knowledge I've acquired. I'm currently pursuing an MBA in Full Stack Web Development. In my free time, I explore new technologies, create personal projects, and follow industry trends.

item3.description: I built a SaaS from scratch and remain actively involved in evolving the product now that it is in production, owning frontend, backend, and architecture. I created the interface with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind, developed the Java and PostgreSQL backend with a multi-tenant architecture, implemented Stripe subscriptions and external integrations, and delivered REST APIs plus an AI chatbot integrated with WhatsApp using LLMs, webhooks, and queue-based asynchronous processing.

item2.description: I worked with a frontend focus using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, leading the migration from a legacy interface to a new modern application. I also built reusable and responsive components, created a full Canva-style post editor, and worked with Git version control and agile routines using Scrum and Kanban.

item1.description: I participated in the planning and execution of multidisciplinary technology projects, collaborating with teams to build practical solutions while applying software development and project organization concepts.

project1.title: Fintegra
project1.description: A personal finance platform with automatic categorization, account and card tracking, budgets, financial goals, and invite-based sharing, ideal for couples and collaborative money management.

project2.title: AuthKit
project2.description: A fullstack enterprise authentication solution with JWT refresh token support, active session management, 2FA, and Passkeys. Includes email verification and account recovery, real-time in-app notifications via WebSocket, protected routes, and more.

details.title: AuthKit - Enterprise Authentication Solution
details.description: AuthKit is a comprehensive authentication solution designed for enterprise-level applications. Built with modern technologies and best practices, it provides a secure and scalable foundation for user authentication and authorization. The project is fully functional and ready to use, serving as a base template for enterprise systems where only the creation of specific pages and dashboards is needed.

project3.title: Valorize
project3.description: A fixed income investment simulator supporting the main types of investments: fixed rate, post-fixed, and IPCA-indexed. The tool includes complete metrics, charts, and a monthly progress table.

details.title: Valorize - Fixed Income Investment Simulator
details.description: A powerful tool for simulating and analyzing fixed income investments. The application supports various investment types and provides detailed metrics and visualizations to help users make informed investment decisions.
